name: cktk
description: Software development and UI design workflow skills.
author: Calvin Ku

skills.name: create-tickets
skills.description: Generate development tickets from a PRD, feature catalog, or Plan Mode plan, with optional design inputs — files, directories, URLs, PDF, PPTX, or HTML (including Claude Design handoff bundles)

skills.name: implement-ticket
skills.description: Implement a specific ticket on its own branch with code review, then offer to merge, open a PR, commit only, or leave it; optionally in an isolated worktree (docs/tickets twin of implement-ticket-linear)

skills.name: clarify-ticket
skills.description: Read a docs/tickets/ ticket and interactively clarify its details and risks against the codebase before implementation — read-only (docs/tickets twin of clarify-ticket-linear)

skills.name: clarify-ticket-linear
skills.description: Fetch a Linear issue and interactively clarify its details and risks against the codebase before implementation — read-only (requires Linear MCP; Linear twin of clarify-ticket)

skills.name: implement-ticket-linear
skills.description: Implement a Linear issue on its own branch with code review, then offer to merge, open a PR, commit only, or leave it; moves a Todo issue to In Progress first and reports any other status before starting; optionally in an isolated worktree (requires Linear MCP; Linear twin of implement-ticket)

skills.name: review-ticket
skills.description: Review code changes for bugs and ticket alignment — diffs, branches, PRs, single commits, docs tickets, or Linear issues (Linear mode requires Linear MCP)

skills.name: update-ticket
skills.description: Update ticket status, checking matching worktrees, cascade dependencies, and refresh INDEX.md (docs/tickets twin of update-ticket-linear)

skills.name: update-ticket-linear
skills.description: Update a Linear issue status after AC evaluation, checking matching linear worktrees (requires Linear MCP; Linear twin of update-ticket)

skills.name: quiz-ticket
skills.description: Quiz your understanding of an implemented docs/tickets/ ticket from its diff, or generate a stakeholder explainer with `explain` — read-only (docs/tickets twin of quiz-ticket-linear)

skills.name: quiz-ticket-linear
skills.description: Quiz your understanding of an implemented Linear issue from its local diff, or generate a stakeholder explainer with `explain` — read-only (requires Linear MCP; Linear twin of quiz-ticket)

skills.name: commit-ticket
skills.description: Create a single git commit from current changes

skills.name: commit-push-pr
skills.description: Create commit, push branch, and open a pull request

skills.name: create-worktree
skills.description: Create git worktrees for one or more tickets, each on its own branch under .worktrees/NNN-slug

skills.name: merge-worktree
skills.description: Merge ticket worktrees back into their base branch, then remove the worktree and delete the local branch

skills.name: feature-catalog
skills.description: Explore a codebase and produce a user-facing feature catalog

skills.name: cktk-upgrade
skills.description: Pull the latest cktk skills from GitHub

skills.name: codex-handoff
skills.description: Export a pending coding task from the current agent into a handoff bundle so Codex can take over

skills.name: grok-handoff
skills.description: Export a pending coding task from any coding agent into a handoff bundle so Grok Build can take over

skills.name: opencode-handoff
skills.description: Export a pending coding task from any coding agent into a handoff bundle so OpenCode can take over

skills.name: takeover
skills.description: Find and continue a pending handoff bundle left by another coding agent

skills.name: interact-html
skills.description: Render agent-user interactions (questions, option picks, briefings) as a local interactive HTML page, collect answers via a one-shot localhost server or paste-back, and archive the resolved page as a decision record

skills.name: design-system-extractor
skills.description: Extract design tokens from UI screenshots into structured JSON

skills.name: design-system-web-applier
skills.description: Generate web theme files from design token JSON

skills.name: design-system-mobile-applier
skills.description: Generate native mobile theme files from design token JSON

skills.name: wcag-accessibility-checker
skills.description: Audit React/Next.js apps for WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance

skills.name: ux-design
skills.description: Generate UX design specification from a PRD using 6 forced designer passes

skills.name: ux-redesign
skills.description: Audit codebase against UX spec and redesign with 6 forced designer passes

skills.name: cinematic-design-system
skills.description: Generate a cinematic design system bundle (4 Markdown docs + 2 HTML previews) from a director and a specific film via a 4-phase workflow

skills.name: readme-builder
skills.description: Generate or refresh README.md from observed codebase facts plus optional UI screenshots via Playwright MCP

skills.name: gen-image-codex
skills.description: Generate images, icons, logos, or banners with gpt-image-2 via the local Codex CLI and save them into the project

skills.name: gen-image-agy
skills.description: Generate images, icons, logos, or banners with Google's Nano Banana via the local Antigravity CLI (agy), billed to the user's Google AI Pro subscription — no API key
